description: A beginner-friendly full-body session built around the five fundamental movement patterns: squat, push, pull, hinge, and brace.

workouts.name: Warm-up
workouts.notes: Raise the pulse and groove the squat pattern before loading.

workouts.name: Main strength
workouts.notes: Rest fully between sets — quality over speed.

exercises.notes: Elevate the hands on a bench if needed.

description: A classic push-pull upper-body session pairing heavy compound presses and rows with an arm superset finisher.

workouts.name: Compound lifts
workouts.notes: First set of each lift is a lighter ramp-up.

workouts.name: Arm superset
workouts.notes: Alternate the two exercises back-to-back, then rest 60 s.

description: A Helen-style benchmark: three rounds of a 400 m run, kettlebell swings, and pull-ups, raced against a 25-minute cap.

workouts.name: 3 rounds for time
workouts.notes: Complete all 3 rounds as fast as possible. Scale pull-ups to ring rows if needed.

description: A single-round descending chipper of simple bodyweight movements — finish the list as fast as you can within 20 minutes.

workouts.name: Chipper — for time
workouts.notes: Work through the list top to bottom, breaking sets as needed.

description: A Cindy-style 20-minute AMRAP of pull-ups, push-ups, and air squats — pure engine work with no equipment beyond a bar.

workouts.name: AMRAP 20 min
workouts.notes: As many rounds as possible in 20 minutes. Pace the first 5 minutes deliberately slow.

description: A friendly 12-minute kettlebell AMRAP mixing swings, goblet squats, and push-ups at a steady, repeatable pace.

workouts.name: AMRAP 12 min
workouts.notes: Move continuously — pick a weight you could swing for 20 unbroken reps when fresh.

description: Sixteen minutes rotating through four power stations — cleans, box jumps, burpees, and double unders — one station per minute.

exercises.notes: Technique ramp-up with a light bar.

workouts.name: EMOM 16 (4-station rotation)
workouts.notes: Minute 1: cleans, minute 2: box jumps, minute 3: burpees, minute 4: double unders — repeat 4 times. Each station's work should take under 40 s.

description: A gentle ten-minute EMOM alternating air squats and plank holds — a perfect first taste of interval structure.

workouts.name: EMOM 10 (alternating)
workouts.notes: Odd minutes: 10 squats. Even minutes: 30 s plank. Whatever remains of each minute is rest.

description: Two classic 8-round Tabatas (20 s on / 10 s off) targeting the core: mountain climbers first, Russian twists second.

workouts.name: Tabata 1 — Mountain Climbers
workouts.notes: 8 rounds of 20 s work / 10 s rest. Rest 60 s before the next Tabata.

workouts.name: Tabata 2 — Russian Twists
workouts.notes: Same clock: 8 × 20 s on / 10 s off.

description: Three back-to-back Tabatas — burpees, kettlebell swings, and high knees — for a brutal, time-efficient full-body finisher.

workouts.name: Tabata 1 — Burpees
workouts.notes: 8 × 20 s on / 10 s off. Rest 90 s between Tabatas.

workouts.name: Tabata 2 — Kettlebell Swings
workouts.notes: Keep every swing crisp — set the bell down if form degrades.
